blind.description: A circular bronze or brass offering bowl with a flared rim and raised circular base foot, filled to near the brim with small golden coins and scattered floral petals/blossoms in red, orange, and yellow. All surfaces are solid, continuous, and properly textured without floating shards or melting.
blind.from_above: A concentric circular bowl with an outer metallic rim, filled with a dense bed of golden coins dotted with small colorful floral blossoms.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1/10 the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 6 inches tall) and about 1 to 1.3 feet in diameter.
